title: Grant admin access to current user and complete Admin Panel actions (Results + Accuracy)

requirements.text: Ensure the currently authenticated user can be granted the Admin role so that the Admin Panel becomes visible and accessible (role-based/hidden admin gating). Provide a safe bootstrap path to make the user an admin when there are no admins yet, or an admin-only promotion path otherwise.

quotes: My account should have admin.Admin Panel (Hidden / Role-based): Add Match, Add Analysis, Build Ticket, Update Results, Track Accuracy; writes to Matches, Analysis, Tickets, Results

acceptanceCriteria: When a user is admin, the PrimaryNav shows the 'Admin' link and '/admin' renders the Admin Panel instead of AccessDeniedScreen.
When a user is not admin, the 'Admin' link is not shown and navigating to '/admin' shows AccessDeniedScreen.

A newly deployed canister with zero admins supports a one-time bootstrap flow that allows the first authenticated user to become admin (subsequent users cannot use the bootstrap flow once an admin exists).
If an admin already exists, only an existing admin can promote another principal to admin.
The frontend refreshes the cached current user role after the admin role is granted (Admin link appears without requiring a hard reload).

requirements.text: Align backend role APIs with frontend expectations by ensuring there is a backend method to return the caller’s role (admin vs non-admin/guest) that matches the frontend’s `useCurrentUser()` usage (currently calling `getCallerUserRole()`).
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a `getCallerUserRole()` (or updates the frontend to use the actual existing role API) so that the app can reliably compute `isAdmin`.
For authenticated non-admin users, the returned role is non-admin; for admins it is admin.
No unauthorized traps occur when an authenticated user calls the role endpoint (it should be callable for signed-in users).

requirements.text: Implement Admin Panel capabilities for 'Update Results' and 'Track Accuracy' end-to-end so that admin actions write/read Results data in the backend and are usable from the Admin Panel UI.

quotes: Admin Panel (Hidden / Role-based): Add Match, Add Analysis, Build Ticket, Update Results, Track Accuracy; writes to Matches, Analysis, Tickets, Results

acceptanceCriteria: Backend has a Results data structure stored in-canister and admin-only mutation(s) to record/update a ticket’s result (e.g., win/loss) and completion time, keyed by ticket id.
Non-admin callers cannot create/update results and receive an authorization failure.
Frontend Admin Panel includes a usable UI to set a ticket result (Win/Loss) for an existing ticket and submit it successfully.
Frontend Admin Panel includes a 'Track Accuracy' view that shows accuracy metrics computed from stored results (at minimum: total decided tickets, wins, losses, win rate %).
Admin Panel success/error toasts are shown in English for results updates and accuracy actions.

ResultsPage continues to function; if it relies on results data, it must read from the backend Results source (or remain consistent with stored results) rather than requiring manual client-only assumptions.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under frontend/immutablePaths (compose existing UI components instead).
All user-facing text must be in English.
nonGoals: Implementing third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Adding real-time updates via websockets/push notifications for admin changes.
Redesigning the global theme/styling beyond what is required to expose and use the Admin Panel functions.
